quests.title: Wangshu Take-Away

dialogue.t: Oh ho, now that's a good answer! Well, off you go, then.
Now, remember not to run or put yourself in harm's way. Otherwise, you'll spill the soup, and the customer will refuse to take it.
That person's really particular. Sometimes I wonder who raised him...

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Tacit Tingfang

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: Sure did. That... guest, Tingfang, ordered some Black-Back Perch Stew earlier.
He said that he wanted it delivered to some place in Sal Terrae...
If you're up for it, why don't you help me take it out to him? You'll be paid for your work.

quests.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...
